title: How do I begin UPSC Mains answer writing practice?

matched_note.title: UPSC CSE Mains Answer Writing Framework: Structure, Committee Quotes & Data Points

drafted_comment:
The real issue most beginners face is trying to write a 'perfect' answer without a structure. You shouldn't start by writing full essays; start by mastering a consistent framework.

Here is how you should begin:

1. Use the 4-Anchor Formula: Every answer should have a Constitutional/Statutory basis, a Macro Data point, a specific Committee quote (like 2nd ARC or NITI Aayog), and a forward-looking Way Forward.
2. Stop using vague generalities: Evaluators look for named institutional recommendations. Instead of saying 'the government should improve infrastructure,' mention a specific Law Commission or Sarkaria Commission suggestion.
3. Practice syllabus-mapped questions: Don't write random topics. Pick one GS syllabus keyword daily and try to frame a 10-marker using the above anchors.
